title: Regression and Residuals
outcome: By the end, I can explain regression and residuals using a traced example and a stated limitation.
scenario: Use residual signs to say whether each plant-height estimate is too high or low.
given: Residual=observed-predicted. Observed heights [5, 8, 12] cm; predicted [7, 7, 10] cm.
All inputs and outcomes in this worked example are invented classroom data; no real model run is claimed.

steps.label: Read directions
steps.detail: First prediction is too high by2; second too low by1; third too low by2.

steps.label: Avoid cancellation
steps.detail: Mean residual is 1/3 cm; MAE is 5/3 cm, so small signed mean does not imply small errors.

explanation: Read the picture in order. Mean residual is 1/3 cm; MAE is 5/3 cm, so small signed mean does not imply small errors. The arrows show which recorded input or intermediate result each decision uses. Explain the deciding step aloud before checking the changed case; pointing to the final answer alone does not show how it follows.

counterfactual.prediction: Residuals become [-3, 0, 1]; mean=-2/3 cm and MAE=4/3 cm.
counterfactual.reason: Each residual decreases by1 under the observed-minus-predicted convention.

student_task: Which statistic reveals the size of errors without cancellation? Point to the relevant step in the picture, then write the changed result and the rule or evidence that supports it.
teacher_answer: MAE: original5/3 cm and changed4/3 cm. Signed mean reports average direction and can hide offsetting errors. Changed-case check: Residuals become [-3, 0, 1]; mean=-2/3 cm and MAE=4/3 cm. Each residual decreases by1 under the observed-minus-predicted convention.
project_evidence: For your Responsible Plant Classifier, save the input, procedure, observed result and limitation of this check. Label this worked example as practice; use a different, previously unreviewed case when checking independent understanding.
limits: Always declare the residual sign convention; some software uses predicted minus observed.
review_note: Reviewed Regression and Residuals against the assigned lesson pack and its reserved independent case. Added a different explicit worked scenario, an auditable trace and a changed-input check; preserved the original curriculum and assessment boundary.
